questions.text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.text: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce most of the cell's ATP energy.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum'.

questions.text: What is the speed of light in a vacuum (approximately)?
Who is credited with founding Microsoft with Paul Allen in 1975?
questions.explanation: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded Microsoft in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

questions.text: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all other planets combined.

questions.text: What does 'CPU' stand for in computing?
questions.explanation: The CPU is the primary component that executes instructions.

questions.text: What is the most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the atmosphere.
